description.en: explain any complex idea simply, teach from first principles
description.zh: 把任何复杂概念说清楚，从第一性原理出发

outcome.en: Apply Feynman's explanation methodology to papers, code, or ideas — if you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it yet.
outcome.zh: 用费曼的解释方法处理论文、代码或想法——如果你说不清楚，说明还没真正理解。

reason.en: Distilled Feynman teaching methodology: first principles, analogy-first explanations, and the "no jargon" rule.
reason.zh: 蒸馏自费曼教学法：第一性原理、类比优先的解释方式，以及"禁用行话"原则。

en: Explain this paper like Feynman would
Break down quantum computing from scratch
Find the simplest mental model for this concept
zh: 像费曼一样解释这篇论文
为这个概念找到最简洁的心智模型

reason.en: Feed any paper or doc to the Feynman skill — summarize first, then explain.
reason.zh: 把任意论文或文档喂给费曼 skill——先摘要，再解释。
